Synthetic fresh sessionStorage did not inherit stale localStorage sessionAttribution; durable anonymous actor and firstTouch remained. Later incoming UTM did not overwrite firstTouch. checks.name: write boundaries and cleanup
checks.details: Only QA evidence written in repository. Synthetic events intercepted in memory; no actual event API request, model/image call, customer asset, account, database write, new server/browser process, push/deploy or control-state mutation. No synthetic assets require cleanup.

limitations: Synthetic browser storage/effect/fetch tests and existing built HTML inspection; no full browser/E2E production check. Fresh-session isolation tested with an empty sessionStorage object, not browser-specific opener/duplicate-tab cloning behavior.
Anonymous session ID remains the pre-existing durable localStorage identifier; session source now lives in sessionStorage. Durable identity was deliberately preserved under the contract.

Existing ActivationView idempotency key is reused for per-route landing; no new event type or database behavior introduced. Synthetic stable rerender and source wiring checked; no production event-count/analytics report assertions.
No GSC/rankings, external distribution, payment/login/customer-data or model-quality checks. No production deployment/enablement/verification.
implementation: Accepted at exact candidate; existing event and storage semantics reused with scoped session-source storage change.
deployment: Not performed or authorized by this QA.
